note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor) after the user-namespace conversion (d8427e4380): the TestGatewayICMPDFDiscard unit gained only `if !userns.Enter(t) { return }` as its first statement and its build tag moved from integration&&linux to linux. userns.Enter (internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go) re-runs the one named test in a fresh user+net+mount namespace and returns false to the parent only when the child reported PASS or SKIP; a failing child, a non-zero exit, or a child that ran nothing calls t.Fatalf, so every assertion below the guard still fails the test when the behaviour breaks. Body otherwise byte-identical. RFC 792 Destination Unreachable: "In this case the gateway must discard the datagram and may return a destination unreachable message." Fresh judgement: a 900-octet DF datagram must not appear on the 576-MTU exit, now configured through Ze's netlinkBackend.SetMTU in routedExit (b8c4909334, helper only), with Fragmentation Needed returned; a DF datagram exactly at MTU and a DF-clear oversize datagram must forward, bounding the rule. newGatewayWire no longer skips on EPERM, which can only make the unit fail more often. Enforced.
